pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What happens on the command set? (1 mark)
   A. The runners raise their hips slightly and stay still
   B. The race ends
   C. The runners run
   D. The runners sit

2. What do the letters WA stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Wing Attack
   B. Winning Arm
   C. Wing Ally
   D. Water Aim

3. What should you do with long hair in gymnastics? (1 mark)
   A. Cut it during class
   B. Let it hang in your face
   C. Cover the mat with it
   D. Tie it back

4. How many finger holes are on the front of the descant recorder? (1 mark)
   A. Twelve
   B. Seven
   C. Five
   D. Three

5. A glide is (1 mark)
   A. a float on the back
   B. a dive
   C. a fast kick
   D. moving through water after a push without kicking

6. Why do we warm up before sprinting? (1 mark)
   A. To prepare muscles and avoid injury
   B. To tire out the muscles
   C. To hide from the starter
   D. To make the track smooth

7. What do the letters GK stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Great Kicker
   B. Goal Kicker
   C. Goal Keeper
   D. Goal King

8. What is clay? (1 mark)
   A. A type of paper
   B. A metal
   C. A kind of wood
   D. Fine sticky soil that is soft when wet and hard when dry

9. What happens if you lift your head during a glide? (1 mark)
   A. You go faster
   B. You fly
   C. Nothing
   D. Your legs sink

10. Why is colour classification useful in painting? (1 mark)
   A. It cleans the brush
   B. It makes paper thicker
   C. It tells us which colours to mix to make others
   D. It makes paint cheaper

11. The steady pulse in a piece of music is called the (1 mark)
   A. melody
   B. beat
   C. lyric
   D. echo

12. Indoors, the best place to stand for better light is (1 mark)
   A. under a table
   B. in a dark corner
   C. in the cupboard
   D. near a window or open door

13. After entering, you should (1 mark)
   A. move away from the edge so the next person can enter
   B. stay at the edge
   C. sit at the top
   D. pull others in

14. Why should you not use very hot water on a plastic recorder? (1 mark)
   A. It makes it play higher
   B. It makes it heavier
   C. It makes it louder
   D. It can bend the plastic

15. How many beats does a crotchet last? (1 mark)
   A. Half
   B. Two
   C. Four
   D. One

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give four steps of a double-handed catch. (4 marks)

17. Why does a drum sound higher when its skin is tightened? (3 marks)

18. Identify the kayamba and the drum by giving the name, the community or area and the way of playing for each. (4 marks)

19. Describe how to do the side roll safely. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — The runners raise their hips slightly and stay still
   On set, runners lift the hips and hold still.

2. A — Wing Attack
   WA is the Wing Attack, who feeds the shooters.

3. D — Tie it back
   Tied-back hair does not get in your way.

4. B — Seven
   There are seven on the front and one thumb hole at the back.

5. D — moving through water after a push without kicking
   Gliding uses the momentum of the push.

6. A — To prepare muscles and avoid injury
   Warm muscles work better and are less likely to be hurt.

7. C — Goal Keeper
   GK is the Goal Keeper, a defender who guards the goal.

8. D — Fine sticky soil that is soft when wet and hard when dry
   Clay is a fine, sticky soil used for modelling.

9. D — Your legs sink
   Lifting the head lowers the legs.

10. C — It tells us which colours to mix to make others
   Knowing primary and secondary colours helps us mix what we need.

11. B — beat
   The beat is the steady pulse we tap or clap along to.

12. D — near a window or open door
   Daylight helps.

13. A — move away from the edge so the next person can enter
   Make space for others.

14. D — It can bend the plastic
   Heat can warp plastic.

15. D — One
   A crotchet lasts for one beat.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Watch the ball into your hands; reach out with both hands; spread the fingers with the thumbs close; bend the arms and pull the ball to the chest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: A tighter skin vibrates faster. Faster vibration makes a higher sound. Ropes are used to tighten the skin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for faster vibration, 1 mark for higher sound, 1 mark for the ropes or tightening.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Kayamba: coastal people such as the Mijikenda, played by shaking. Drum (ngoma): found in many communities, played with hands or sticks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name, community or area and method, up to 4.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Lie on the back with body straight. Stretch the arms overhead with palms together and legs together. Tighten the tummy and point the toes. Roll over on to the side and tummy in a straight line. Get up slowly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.
